title: Ultra-Euclidean functions: the refinement conjecture is false
summary: The refinement of an ultra-Euclidean function need not be ultra-Euclidean.
source: S. Sekhon, "A Necessary and Sufficient Condition for Uniqueness of Euclidean Division", arXiv:2604.24399v2 (April 2026), section "Further investigation".
label: lean
